# Insights Collective

> A learning platform for data, analytics and AI careers: courses, career pathway tools, interview prep and a hands-on quiz that maps your skills to a data role.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Insights Collective is, plus the career-fit quiz and featured courses.
- [Courses](/courses): Catalog of data, analytics and AI courses.
- [Explore data careers](/explore-data-careers): Role profiles, skills and wage data for data careers.
- [Career pathway](/career-pathway): Build a step-by-step plan toward a target data role.
- [Interview prep](/interview-prep): Mock interviews, STAR practice and coding practice.
- [Resources](/resources): Guides, tools and reference material for learners.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming workshops, cohorts and community sessions.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on data careers, skills and learning.
- [Surveys](/survey): Open surveys and intake forms.

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](/privacy-policy): How learner data is collected and used.
- [Terms of service](/terms-of-service): Terms for using the platform.
